VA transport Greene County Veterans Affairs serving the veterans and families of Greene County since 1946.
Veterans Services The Greene County Veterans' Service Office is responsible for assisting veterans, their spouses, dependents and survivors with information and assistance concerning veterans' benefits through Federal and State levels.
Greene County Veterans Officer Norman Sullivan is NACVSO accredited and works with IDVA in Indiana.
The Veterans' Service Office offers a full range of services, including assisting veterans and survivors with applications for these benefits.
Please call for information about van transportation to Roudebush VA Medical Center Indianapolis.
